description_en: Retrieves a list of configurable log sources for custom rules
description_zh: 获取自定义规则可配置日志源列表
kebab_example: aliyun cloud-siem describe-log-source --log-type HTTP_ACTIVITY --role-type 1 --role-for 1130916744880000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2022-06-16 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeLogSource

parameters.help_en: The log type of the rule
parameters.name: log_type

parameters.help_en:
The view type.

0: The view of the current Alibaba Cloud account.

1: The view of all accounts within the enterprise
parameters.help_zh:
视图类型。

0：当前阿里云账号视图。
1：企业下所有账号的视图
parameters.name: role_type

parameters.help_en: The user ID of the member. An administrator can use this parameter to switch to the perspective of a member
parameters.help_zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID
parameters.name: role_for

parameters.help_en:
The region where the Data Management center of Threat Analysis is deployed. You must select the region where your assets are located. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: Your assets are in the Chinese mainland or China (Hong Kong).

ap-southeast-1: Your assets are in regions outside China
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地与中国香港
ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
parameters.name: region_id
